newsitem.title: INDIA: India Dr Reddy's falls 7.5 pct on result.
newsitem.headline: India Dr Reddy's falls 7.5 pct on result.

text.p: Shares of Indian pharmaceutical firm, Dr Reddy's Labarotories dropped 17.25 rupees, or 7.5 percent, to 212.75 at the Bombay exchange on Monday, after the firm announced poor annual results after the market had closed on Friday, traders said.
Dr Reddy's on Friday announced a 33 percent fall in 1996/97 (April-March) net profit to 335.27 million rupees from 501.78 million in the year-ago period.
A 120.8 million rupees fall in other income and one-time write-off of 39.32 million rupees on investment losses and lower bulk drug prices affected net profits, the firm said.
